description: This file is a JUnit test class for the ModuleFileParser class within the OpenMRS project. It contains extensive unit tests covering various scenarios of parsing module configuration XML files encapsulated within JAR files, including validation and error handling.

classes.name: ModuleConfigXmlBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing XML documents with module configuration data for testing.

classes.name: AccessibleExtension
classes.description: An inner class extending Extension, used for testing parsing of extension elements.

methods.name: expectModuleExceptionWithMessage
methods.description: Asserts that executing the provided code throws a ModuleException with a message starting with the specified string.

methods.name: whenGettingMessageFromMessageSourceServiceWithKeyReturnSameKey
methods.description: Mocks the messageSourceService to return the message key itself when queried.

methods.name: buildOnValidConfigXml
methods.description: Creates a builder preconfigured with valid module configuration XML elements.

methods.name: writeConfigXmlToFile
methods.description: Writes a DOM Document to a JAR file as 'config.xml' inside the temporary folder for parsing.

methods.name: createJarWithConfigXmlEntry
methods.description: Creates a JAR OutputStream with an entry named 'config.xml' prepared for writing configuration data.

methods.name: writeConfigXmlToJar
methods.description: Writes a DOM Document as bytes into an existing JarOutputStream.

methods.name: getByteArray
methods.description: Converts a DOM Document into a byte array for writing into a JAR.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Serializes a DOM Document into a String using DOMImplementationLS.

methods.name: registerModuleClassloader
methods.description: Associates a Module with its ModuleClassLoader in the ModuleFactory's map, used to ensure proper extension instantiation.
